name: cache-keepwarm
description: Protect cached context — Keep main-chat and sub-agent background waits warm with visible pokes, capped per wait, under rewrite-saving budgets.

enabled.title: Keep tracked waits warm
enabled.description: Keep qualifying background waits warm with visible pokes. The launch default; /keepwarm on or off overrides it for this session.

minContext.title: Minimum context tokens
minContext.description: Do not poke a main chat with a smaller context; its rewrite is cheap.

maxPokes.title: Pokes per wait
maxPokes.description: Send at most this many keep-warm pokes to one thread while its pending items stay the same and nothing else happens; any real activity or a changed set of items starts a fresh count.

subagents.title: Poke waiting sub-agents
subagents.description: Poke waiting sub-agents that own attributable pending work. Each sub-agent poke also wakes its parent for one real turn, which the budget forecast counts.

subagentMinContext.title: Minimum sub-agent context tokens
subagentMinContext.description: Do not poke a sub-agent with a smaller context; with the parent wake, a smaller rewrite is not worth saving.

status.title: Show the status text
status.description: Show the waiting and stopped status text under the prompt. Off, it paints only problems (bad options, a failed log write); /keepwarm status and the session-state JSON are unaffected.
